sections.text: Python, ROS 2, Robotics, Git, Gazebo, Kubernetes
Research Assistant (part-time), University Robotics Lab (Aug 2025 - Aug 2026). Supported ROS 2 experiments for a manipulator arm and maintained the lab's Git repository.

Final-year project: an autonomous rover using ROS 2 and Gazebo simulation for path planning. Separate academic project: deployed a small microservice to a Kubernetes cluster on a university-provided cloud account, including manifests and a rolling update demonstration.
My robotics work is largely academic but hands-on. My cloud deployment experience is limited to a university project rather than production.
